opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK with a formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK host institution; individuals without such affiliation, schools, colleges, undergraduates, PhD fee projects, and organisations not based in the UK are ineligible, except in exceptional cases.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions, aiming to improve lives in the UK. Up to two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse and racially minoritised backgrounds, particularly UK‑based organisations; partnership applications are welcomed. Applicants should have a UK host institution.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and contributing to public debate, policy and practice on racial inequalities.
